author: Ariadne I
title: RC-DualDecay (k=128) + Per-Factor Temporal Gating + Curvature Reg
abstract: Extends RC-DualDecay with per-factor temporal gates S[t,k] to modulate factor activity across the 32-step horizon, plus MAE with temporal curvature regularization and global-norm clipping. Uses k=128, gamma schedule 0.25→0.9, and column-normalized loadings to capture rich population structure while remaining efficient.
